[[File:Ataru_Striker_FDSS.png|thumb|right|250px|An Ataru Striker makes an aggressive leaping strike.]]
'''Ataru Strikers''' were a specialized group of [[Jedi Seeker/Legends|Jedi Seekers]] that practiced [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]] in order to end fights as quickly as possible.<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> Ataru Strikers were thought to tread close to the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] due to their aggressive actions of quickly drawing their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to start or end a conflict.<ref name="SS">''[[Savage Spirits]]''</ref>

Forced to survive on uncivilized worlds devoid of medical care where even minor injuries proved fatal, these warriors channeled raw athleticism and environmental awareness into a decisive advantage. They fought with reckless abandon, unleashing a relentless flurry of swift, multi-directional attacks that served as their sole form of defense and overwhelmed foes before they could strike back. Yet this frantic, energy-consuming style was a double-edged sword; any resilient adversary who managed to endure the initial onslaught could easily turn the tide once exhaustion inevitably set in.<ref name="FDCR" />
